title: BUG: pd.concat inconsistent behaviour with empty and tz-aware Series

labels.name: Needs Tests
labels.description: Unit test(s) needed to prevent regressions

body:
```python
df = pd.concat([
    pd.Series(dtype=float), 
    pd.Series(index=[pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00')], data=0, dtype=float)], 
axis=1)
>>> df
                            0    1
2020-01-01 00:00:00+00:00 NaN  0.0
```

```python
df = pd.concat([
    pd.Series(index=[pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01T00:00:00')], data=0, dtype=float), 
    pd.Series(dtype=float)],    
axis=1)
>>> df
              0   1
2020-01-01  0.0 NaN
```
